crossRefs.note: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or…
He said, “At this season, when the time comes around, you will embrace a son.” She said, “No, my lord, you man of God…

translations.web: Then she said, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me’?”
translations.bsb: Then she said, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me?’”
translations.kjv: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?
translations.asv: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?
